ds.workflow_retrying: Could not read the operation status. The operation may still be running; retrying automatically.
ds.workflow_disconnected: Could not read the operation status after repeated attempts. The operation may still be running. Refresh its status before starting another action.
ds.skip_tls_hint: For APIs with self-signed certificates. Disables certificate and hostname verification for all requests from this source only. Off by default.
ds.title: Synchronization
ds.intro: Import teams and on-call schedules, or services and business services from Jira Assets.
ds.name: Name
ds.headers_hint: Stored encrypted and never returned. Leave blank to keep existing headers; {} clears them.
ds.operations_hint: Configure teams, optional team/user, shifts and optional current. Each operation has method, path, params, body, items and pagination.
ds.mapping_hint: Save the connection and inspect response fields first. Use dotted paths or {"value": ...} constants. Match existing teams through team_matches: external ID → local team ID.
ds.enabled_save_first: Save the source, preview the changes and apply the preview before enabling periodic synchronization.
ds.enabled_apply_first: Preview the changes and apply the preview for this configuration before enabling periodic synchronization.
ds.enabled_wait: Wait for the current operation to finish before changing periodic synchronization.
ds.behavior_hint: Local edits to imported fields are replaced by the next sync. Only managed objects are removed, within successfully fetched data. Shared user accounts are retained. Changes to the API address, credentials, imported data or import rules require a new preview. Operational and current-duty settings can be saved directly.
ds.worker_hint: The scheduler worker processes queued runs. Current duty is refreshed separately; expired answers are never used for assignment.
ds.invalid_json: Check JSON syntax in headers, operations and mapping.
ds.saved: Configuration saved. Inspect response fields or preview the import.
ds.local_shift_hint: Times are UTC. Local edits affect assignment and can be overwritten by the next synchronization.
ds.automatic_match: Match automatically or create a team
ds.saved_approved: Configuration saved. No new preview is required.
ds.preview_queued: Preview queued; waiting for the scheduler…
ds.apply_queued: Apply queued; waiting for the scheduler…
ds.run_queued: Sync queued; waiting for the scheduler…
ds.source_busy: Wait for the queued or running operation to finish, then reload the list.
ds.keep_data_hint: Teams and saved shifts remain editable. Assignments use the saved schedule; no further data is fetched. All user accounts are kept.
ds.delete_data_hint: Teams created by this source, their dependent configuration, source-created rotations and imported shifts will be deleted. Previously existing teams and all user accounts are kept.
ds.retained_hint: Choose a deleted source in this group. Preview reviews the reconnection and any upstream changes; Apply reuses teams, schedules and shift history by external ID. The choice is fixed after the first import.
ds.current_enabled: Check current on-call assignee via API
ds.current_hint: When off, IR uses imported shifts and replacements. When on, it uses the current-duty API; automatic checks follow the source schedule.
ds.current_interval_hint: 10–3600 seconds, including retries after errors. Changing this value restarts the interval from save time. Expired answers are not used until the next check.
ds.current_missing: Configure the current operation in API operations before enabling current-duty API checks.
ds.workflow_save: 1. Save your settings. IR will show whether a preview is needed.
ds.workflow_preview: 2. Settings saved. Generate a preview to review the import changes.
ds.workflow_apply: 3. Review the changes and apply the preview.
ds.workflow_saved: Settings saved. No new preview is required.
ds.workflow_expired: The preview expired. Generate a new preview before applying changes.
ds.apply_needs_preview: Generate a preview and wait for it to finish first.
ds.run_after_preview: Apply the prepared preview before running another import.
ds.schedule_after_apply: When selected, the schedule starts or resumes automatically after Apply succeeds.
ds.schedule_preview_pause: Automatic imports are paused while this preview awaits review.
ds.type_jira_assets: Services and business services · Jira CMDB
ds.cmdb_query_hint: Choose any object types or schemas using two AQL queries. System and Product are editable examples. Queries must not select the same objects.
ds.cmdb_mapping_hint: Save and load fields to choose attributes from Jira. Lifecycle status is stored as CMDB information and does not override operational health.
ds.cmdb_team_hint: Select owner fields independently above, then load teams again. Match CMDB object IDs to existing active IR teams. This source never creates teams.
ds.cmdb_resolve_issues: Resolve these mappings, save and create a new preview
ds.workflow_inspect: Load the selected objects to discover their fields and owner teams before previewing changes.
ds.workflow_mapping: Choose the fields and match teams. Save any changes, then preview. All mappings must be resolved before Apply.
ds.inspect_queued: Loading Jira fields and teams is queued…
ds.cmdb_delete_data: Delete imported services and business services
ds.cmdb_keep_data_hint: Keep imported objects and their configuration. A new source for the same Jira and destination group can reconnect them by external ID.
ds.cmdb_delete_data_hint: Delete objects created by this source and their dependent configuration. Existing IR teams are retained.
